**ON THE p-ADIC BEILINSON CONJECTURE FOR NUMBER FIELDS**

*AMNON BESSER, PAUL BUCKINGHAM, ROB DE JEU*

44 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** We formulate a conjectural p-adic analogue of Borel’s theorem re- lating regulators for higher K-groups of number ﬁelds to special values of the corresponding ζ-functions, using syntomic regulators and p-adic L-functions. We also formulate a corresponding conjecture for Artin motives, and state a conjecture about the precise relation between the p-adic and classical situa- tions. Parts of the conjectures are proved when the number ﬁeld (or Artin motive) is Abelian over the rationals, and all conjectures are veriﬁed numeri- cally in some other cases.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 The p-adiccomingchar Beilinson conjecture fo; 3 A motivic version of the conjecture; 4 More explicit K -groups and regulators; 5 Computing K -groups in practice; 7 Examples; References
